$comment: Workflow Protocol v1 error vocabulary. Consumers branch ONLY on Error.code, so the protocol enum is closed: a producer maps its own reason ledger onto these codes at its job facade and never leaks internal codes across the boundary. This file is machine-checked by scripts/verify-protocol-v1.py (protocol_codes must equal the schema enum; every producer_internal target must exist; every code of the producer's TerminalReasonCode union must be mapped when the producer checkout is reachable).
retryable_source_of_truth: A payload's own Error.retryable wins when present; the table below is the default a producer must send and a consumer must fall back to.

no_candidate.summary: The producer searched and found nothing the request could accept (may include everything excluded/duplicate).

source_error.summary: The upstream content source failed (network, HTTP error, download, metadata).

auth_error.summary: Upstream credentials are invalid; the operator must act before a retry can help.

quota_exceeded.summary: The producer is rate limited or out of quota; retry after backing off.

resource_busy.summary: The producer could not start the work (queue/account contention).

queued_too_long.summary: Admitted but never started within the queued budget.

stalled_no_progress.summary: Started, then stopped making progress (heartbeat lost) until its budget expired.

deadline_exceeded.summary: The whole job exceeded its hard deadline (including an execution timeout).

idempotency_conflict.summary: The idempotency key was reused with different parameters.

unsupported_protocol_version.summary: The producer does not serve the requested protocol version.

invalid_params.summary: The request failed the declared params_schema.

delivery_failed.summary: The result existed but the handoff to the delivery platform failed.

delivery_rejected.summary: The delivery platform rejected the result; the contract or the content must change.

delivery_abandoned.summary: A delivery intent had no actionable retry left, so the producer converged it as failed.

internal_error.summary: Anything the producer could not classify; detail carries the internal code for diagnosis.

producer_internal.$comment: PixivFlow's scheduler terminal reason codes (src/scheduler/TargetOutcome.ts TerminalReasonCode) mapped onto the closed protocol enum.
